notes.title: Patch note 0.5.0
notes.notes:
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[b]Bot and Tic[/b]

[list]
[*] Added a save system to make it easier to navigate after reaching certain checkpoints.
[*] Added a hint system that appears after some time in levels to better guide players.
[*] Optimized the session creation system (no more issues where you had to close the game to create or join a session).
[*] Improved FPS in level 2 and fixed a crash when the fireworks effect played too many times.
[*] Added a UI for displaying tips.
[*] Minor gameplay fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: V 0.4.0 early access
notes.notes:
Bot & Tic - Patch Notes v0.4.0

Hello Explorers!

We're excited to bring you version 0.4.0 of Bot & Tic with several key improvements and fixes to enhance your gameplay experience. Here’s what’s new:

🔧 Optimizations

Significant performance improvements for smoother gameplay on all configurations.

🌍 UI & Localization Overhaul

The entire user interface has been redesigned for better readability and usability.

Full revision of translations to ensure clarity and consistency across languages.

🐞 Bug Fixes

Fixed multiple bugs affecting the tutorial and its visual elements.

Various minor bugs have been resolved to improve overall stability.

🎮 Gameplay Enhancements

Tweaks and improvements to core gameplay mechanics for a more engaging experience.

Thank you for your continued support! More updates are on the way as we move closer to release.

notes.title: Update 0.3.5 – New Grab System, Translations & Tutorial!

• \[b]Post-process system reworked\[/b] entirely: lighting tone, effects and visual clarity improved.[/p][p][/p][p]\[b]\[u]🔧 Optimizations & Visual Improvements\[/u]\[/b]

• \[b]Light setup optimized\[/b] to reduce visual noise and improve contrast.[/p][p][/p][p]\[b]\[u]🧩 Gameplay Tweaks\[/u]\[/b]

• Added \[b]language selector\[/b] to the settings menu.[/p][p][/p][p]\[i]Thanks again for playing Bot & Tic! This update brings us closer to a polished full version!\[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45491564/a2b109f0582ea466d22d5835e2dda1c852593bfc.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: BUG : Session join bug
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Bot & Tic players,[/p][p]We’re currently experiencing a [b]known issue[/b] that can make it difficult to [b]join multiplayer sessions[/b]. Players may encounter loading freezes or connection failures.[/p][p]🔍 [b]What we know:[/b]
The issue mainly occurs when players [b]alt-tab or leave the game window during loading screens[/b].[/p][p]✅ [b]Temporary solutions:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Do not leave or minimize the game window while loading.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]If the issue occurs, fully restart the game.[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Avoid setting a password on sessions for now,[/b] as it may increase the chance of connection problems.[/p][/*][/list][p]🛠️ Our team is actively working on a fix. Thank you for your patience and continued support![/p][p]— The [b]Twinties Studio[/b] Team[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45491564/29abe8bf28f8edded0d2b6429c03aadfaf373317.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Bot & Tic: Early Access is coming soon on Steam!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45491564/c3592869cedc38f5771eaff1ffd388d8a994f71a.png[/img]

[b][h1]Hey everyone![/h1][/b]

We’re thrilled to announce that[u][b] Bot & Tic[/b][/u], our quirky co-op space adventure, is gearing up for its Early Access release on Steam!

In this [b]first-person[/b], two-player [b]cooperative puzzle[/b] game, you and a friend will team up as Bot and Tic, two aspiring assistant robots on a mission to earn your reliability certification from the intergalactic corporation, Botopia.

Navigate through a series of [b]brain-teasing challenges[/b], pilot next-gen spaceships, and even master the basics of interstellar music—all set in a retro-futuristic universe with a cartoon twist.

[b]Communication[/b] and [b]teamwork[/b] are key as you tackle puzzles and prove your worth. Whether you're tightening bolts or charting a course through the stars, every task brings you closer to becoming the elite of assistant robots.

We're incredibly [b]excited[/b] to share this journey with you and can't wait to see how you and your co-op partner tackle the challenges ahead.

Stay tuned for the official [b]Early Access[/b] launch date, and in the meantime, add Bot & Tic to your wishlist to be notified as soon as it's available:
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3511810/

[b]Thank you[/b] for your support, and we look forward to embarking on this adventure [b]togethe[/b]r!
